hardware: native aarch64 Neoverse N2, GitHub ubuntu-24.04-arm, 4 vCPU
runtime_kernel_evidence: kleidiai: primary q4 kernel feature I8MM
selection_policy: Maximum tg128 among profiles within 2% of best pp512, then maximum pp1024 across frozen batch pairs; deterministic tie-breakers prefer lower RSS and smaller settings.
limitations: This is an exploratory selection run, not independent confirmation.
Three within-process repetitions were used per candidate.
The selected profile must pass a separately committed ABBA confirmation and both optimized-context model quality gates.
